quest.title: A Record of All Things
quest.description: Within the ruins, Kliment and Wanyan each betray the contract in turn for personal reasons. As punishment, Kliment is cast out of the ruin and deprived of his reward. Wanyan is made to witness a truth that shatters her beliefs — the God of Salt was gentle but weak and was betrayed and slain as a result. Bearing witness to this incident and filled with conflicted feelings as a result, you follow Zhongli back to Guyun Stone Forest.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x60, Mora x17050, Guide to Gold x5, Adventurer's Experience x8, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to Guyun Stone Forest and talk to Zhongli

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Now, I mentioned before that many gods of old have been sealed beneath the Guyun Stone Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The adepti have presently handed Liyue over to mortals, and Havria's time was even further in the past. The salt chalice and salt ruler that she left behind should not return to Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: To leave them here is to let them slumber, and it is also a homecoming...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what would you like us to do?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I ended an era with my own two hands. I have always wondered how I should... remember that which I ended.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: History records, but history may be changed. This incident proved that. Time is a mighty force, and histories twist in its flow...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I need to find a better way of recording history in order to engrave its truth.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Stone carvings were one such ancient method. But unchanging stone, immovable earth, even one such as myself... Someday, we may all disappear.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Therefore, I thought of you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You are one who crosses the celestial atlas, and who passes through countless worlds. If our history is engraved in your memory, it will one day accompany you into another world.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As long as a Traveler like you is able to record what happened, then a backup of sorts will exist for times and tides of Teyvat.

choices.text: So that's why you wanted us to come with you.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Now then, it is time that we consigned both the salt chalice and salt ruler to the sea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why do we need to throw them into the sea?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: As I said before... This is the place to which the remnants of many bygone gods are consigned.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: This includes Osial, Overlord of the Vortex, who the Jade Chamber most recently returned to this ocean prison...

choices.text: So you didn't just bring me along to find treasure?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hahaha... Well, may you find treasure among the stars, even after you have left Teyvat.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Now, I am the God of Wealth, so I would think that my words have some weight here.

talks.objective: Consign the relics to the ocean
